mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.published_wasm_catalog_snapshots (game_id, version_id, version_code, schema_version, schema_hash, rules_hash, catalog_json, created_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{versionId}, #{versionCode}, #{schemaVersion}, #{schemaHash}, #{rulesHash}, CAST(#{catalogJson} AS jsonb), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, version_code) DO UPDATE SET version_id = EXCLUDED.version_id, schema_version = EXCLUDED.schema_version, schema_hash = EXCLUDED.schema_hash, rules_hash = EXCLUDED.rules_hash, catalog_json = EXCLUDED.catalog_json, created_at = NOW()
